title: Android Installation
subtitle: Follow these simple steps to install the CamerTrace application on your Android phone.
banner_desc: The application is signed and secure. Downloading the APK directly allows you to enjoy all our features with ease.
uninstall_old_app: Already installed CamerTrace? Uninstall the old “camertrace.cm” app first: the new version does not replace it automatically. Your account and data are kept.
step_1_desc: Tap the download button above. If your browser shows a warning about APK files, tap <bold>Download anyway</bold> or <bold>Keep</bold>.
step_2_desc: Open the downloaded APK file. If a system prompt blocks the installation:
step_2_bullet_1: Click <bold>Settings</bold> in the dialog box that appears.
step_3_desc: Once authorization is granted, return to the installation screen and tap <bold>Install</bold>. Wait for the process to complete.
step_4_desc: The CamerTrace app is now installed. You can open it directly or find it in your applications.
